name: What is the difference between a custom-built backyard office and a pre-fabricated one?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a custom-built backyard office and a pre-fabricated one?

acceptedAnswer.text: A custom-built backyard office is designed from the ground up to your specific aesthetic preferences, functional needs, and site conditions, offering complete control over layout, materials, and features. Pre-fabricated offices are manufactured off-site and assembled on your property, often providing a quicker and sometimes more cost-effective solution with limited customization. Custom builds offer more flexibility for unique spaces and specific requirements, while pre-fabs can be a faster route to a functional workspace.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom-built offices offer full design control and unique adaptation, while pre-fabricated units are quicker, often more affordable, but have limited customization options.
